RESOURCE19.ActualCause: Complete default-on process-owned allocation/root/GC/policy provider is absent; a private tuple/list/map/HAMT/float/bignum backend is implemented, not an ERTS-wide resource provider.
ImplementTogether: Actual allocation/header/raw-word accounting with separately named private metrics; retain pointer-payload counters.
Complete all guest allocation domains and roots, including source/BEAM continuation stacks and escape boundaries; admit ordinary references only with exact factory/source provenance.
One immutable per-VM defaults snapshot + child policy, size-class min heap, binary virtual heap, max size/kill/error_logger/include_shared_binaries, fullsweep propagation.
Transactional admission/allocation safe points with complete live graph roots before GC or quota decisions, rollback on refusal and kill only the logical owning VM/process per policy.
Remote/asynchronous GC executes on target actor safe points, never under runtime gate; aggregate actual per-VM collection events.
Expose process_info four missing fields and flags/statistics only after truthful domains and defaults; preserve list order/duplicates/error metadata.
StillMissing: Refs/PID/port/external-identity and resource/magic-reference boxed ownership (ordinary-ref562 packet is not yet this clean main).
Function closure/export descriptors and environment ownership; literal vs process heap classification.
Binary heap wrappers/offheap virtual-heap age/pressure policy distinct from existing genuine payload leases.
Source/BEAM continuation/try/return/hibernate stack and all producer ingress, message fragments, ETS/persistent/host/native cross-owner boundaries.
Automatic collection on allocation pressure and actual heap capacity growth/shrink policy, not just explicit private self-GC.

LIFECYCLE4.ActualCause: Original proc_lib reports depend on missing physical process_info and native hibernate stack/heap compaction; distributed reports also depend on real rpc/logger path.
ImplementTogether: Run original proc_lib module as preferred library backend; preserve legacy C# backend limits independently.
Attach genuine root custody to hibernate transfer arguments before actor suspension, then stack teardown and owned GC/shrink at actor safe point.
Use complete provider for own and neighbour heap/stack/reductions fields; retain whole report/log/error stacks and actual neighbour liveness.
Exercise init_p/3,5, wake_up/3, hibernate/3 together with original source workers and explicit sleep/wake/cancel barriers.

NIF1.ActualCause: A working ordinary/reviewed ABI subset is not full load_nif/2 callback/dependency/lifecycle compatibility.
ImplementTogether: Compose and genuinely execute pending native resource type/payload/DSO ownership, takeover vs fresh load/purge and destructor host-scope corrections.
Close callback families required by real selected stock NIFs: resources, locks/conditions, system_info/init support; preserve actual supported-platform gates.
Test original load errors and full stacks at current selected metadata image, direct/indirect callers, old/current/reload/upgrade generations, loader dependency search and cleanup.
Bind all final native sources/partial families in all affected source plans before any expensive regression.
StillMissing: UpgradeUnsupported remains an explicit image admission failure in clean main.
Windows callback table is zero-initialized then assigns only reviewed callbacks; absent families are not safe to invoke.
Foreign thread, unload/takeover/callback pins and logical-vs-physical retirement must be demonstrated by native fixture execution, not managed object tests.
